sources.title: GPT-OSS 20B for local AI in 2026: 225 tok/s on RTX 4090, the 128k ...
sources.snippet: TL;DR: gpt-oss-20b is OpenAI's first Apache 2.0 model and it fits on any 16 GB GPU — but only if you keep context under 8k. At 128k context, generation collapses to ~9 tok/s regardless of GPU. On an RTX 4090 with context capped at 8k, you get 225 tok/s. The 20B model is the one home-lab builders should pull; the 120B requires an H100.
